advanced materials.  Everything from FDA, USDA and Kosher compliant resins.

# Bulk Storage Solutions Built for What’s Next

## Precision. Reliability. Peace of Mind.

CST^{®} Industries is the global leader in the design, manufacture and construction of engineered
storage solutions, delivering innovative tanks, silos, covers and related systems to customers
across a wide variety of business sectors. With over 130 years of experience, CST combines
engineering expertise with proven product performance across thousands of installations in more than
125 countries. This unmatched versatility allows CST to meet virtually any customer need, regardless
of application, site conditions or industry.

### How can we help?

[ Inquiry ][202]

### The CST Advantage

CST holds a unique position as the only global storage tank supplier capable of delivering a full
suite of engineered solutions — including glass-fused-to-steel tanks, bolted epoxy tanks,
factory-welded tanks, aluminum domes and specialty covers — backed by a worldwide manufacturing and
service footprint. We deliver products that out-perform, for decades.

### Engineering

Our in-house teams work closely with customers to design custom solutions that meet stringent
project requirements, environmental conditions and global standards. With deep expertise across
structural, mechanical and coatings disciplines, CST engineers contribute to industry codes,
ensuring every product meets or exceeds performance expectations.

### Technology

CST sets itself apart through a suite of proprietary technologies that enhance product performance,
durability and ease of installation. The ability to integrate these innovations under one roof
allows us to better meet complex engineering demands with greater consistency, speed and long-term
value than our competitors.

### Global Footprint

With manufacturing in North America and Europe, and engineering and sales offices across Asia, the
Middle East and Latin America, CST has the geographic reach to minimize lead times, reduce shipping
costs and navigate regional logistics. Projects stay on schedule and within budget, no matter the
location.

### Sustainability

CST is deeply committed to sustainability and environmental stewardship, integrating responsible
practices into every aspect of our operations. From the materials we source to the products we
engineer, CST prioritizes solutions that reduce environmental impact and support long-term resource
conservation.

## Building for the Future Since 1893

For over a century, CST has pushed the boundaries of what storage solutions can do. Our products are
built to last — and so are the values behind them. Generations of skilled workers have poured their
expertise and heart into our products. This is more than a business for us. It’s a point of pride
for American manufacturing.

### Connect with our experts.

allows us to better meet complex engineering demands with greater consistency, speed and long-term
value than our competitors.

Middle East and Latin America, CST has the geographic reach to minimize lead times, reduce shipping
costs and navigate regional logistics. Projects stay on schedule and within budget, no matter the
location.

### Sustainability

CST is deeply committed to sustainability and environmental stewardship, integrating responsible
practices into every aspect of our operations. From the materials we source to the products we
engineer, CST prioritizes solutions that reduce environmental impact and support long-term resource
conservation.

built to last — and so are the values behind them. Generations of skilled workers have poured their
expertise and heart into our products. This is more than a business for us. It’s a point of pride
for American manufacturing.

website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

## SUPERIOR BOLTED AND WELDED STEEL STORAGE TANKS

Superior Tank can help with everything for water and oil storage; from tank engineering, bolted &
welded tank manufacturing and tank installation. We were founded on three basic principles:
continuous innovation, a focus on quality and treating people with respect and integrity.

BOLTED STEEL STORAGE TANKS

Fast assembly with minimal site impact.
Manufactured with exceptional precision.
Powder coated, HDG & Stainless Steel available.
ISO 9001:2015 quality assurance certification.
NSF 61/372 Certified tanks available.
Available from 10,000 to 2,500,000 gallons.

WELDED STEEL STORAGE TANKS

Field fabricated by skilled craftsmen. Constructed of heavy gauge carbon steel. Fused together by
certified welders. Specialized field liquid coatings. Smooth, seamless appearance & construction.
Available from 10,000 to 2,500,000 gallons.

## We will exceed the expectations of our clients!

Tank Connection is the global leader in dry bulk and liquid storage systems, providing a complete
performance package to suit our client’s needs. Tank Connection designs, manufactures and installs
all four major steel storage tank types including bolted tanks, field welded tanks, shop welded
tanks and hybrid storage tanks. Along with our major steel tank offerings we have become a premier
provider of [aluminum dome covers][24] and [composite pedestal storage designs.][25]

In addition to comprehensive manufacturing and superior service, Tank Connection delivers customized
tank fabrication to suit the needs of your location. Expert industrial designers and shop
technicians with decades of experience in tank production turn your specifications into a
specialized tank built to last. Tank Connection provides the industry's leading quality ratings,
with customer testimonials and reviews to support each product. Streamlined, vertical integration of
the Tank Connection family eliminates external costs and translates into leading competitive pricing
and top quality.

### Featured Projects

#### Barge-To-Truck Cement Terminal · Bacadera Port, Aruba

Tank Connection construction crews installed this Barge-to-Truck transloading terminal with a 127’
tall by 41.5’ diameter RTP bolted Cement Storage Silo to store and transfer cement from ocean
barges. Tank Connection also designed, supplied and installed the pneumatic conveying piping and the
unloading system.

[View Project][26]

Barge-To-Truck Cement Terminal · Bacadera Port, Aruba[View Project][27]

## What We Do

By listening to the client’s needs, we provide storage tank solutions that remedy the problems faced
in the past. With over 2,100 years of combined industry experience, Tank Connection personnel are
experts in dry bulk and [liquid storage][28] applications, covering all sectors and industries
including minerals and mining, power facilities, water and wastewater, oil and gas, chemicals

### Welcome to
### Tanks Direct

When you’re sourcing water or petroleum tanks for a project your first choice should be the safe
choice. You want the highest quality tank for the best price point. You need to be confident your
installation will be completed by subject matter experts that can anticipate and solve problems
before they happen. And you want to know that you have proven industry specialists that have the
capacity and flexibility to deliver value at any point in your storage tank lifecycle.

Tanks Direct is the leading national industry contractor that offers full-service solutions for
water and petroleum storage. Partnering with customers from design through construction and
installation, to maintenance and removal, we strive to be your “first choice.” As a single source
storage tank distributor, you can count on our expertise and knowledge at any life cycle stage of
your tank needs.

From design and installation to maintenance and removal, you get industry experts guiding you
through any challenge you face. Tanks Direct understands what’s at stake when you need fire
suppression tanks to protect valuable infrastructure assets or emergency generator fuel oil systems
to keep critical operations running during a disaster. You can’t afford mistakes or delays. Choosing
Tanks Direct is the safe choice because you get your project completed with the best equipment at
the best price – on time and on budget. And done right the first time.

### Welcome to

When you’re sourcing water or petroleum tanks for a project your first choice should be the safe
choice. You want the highest quality tank for the best price point. You need to be confident your
installation will be completed by subject matter experts that can anticipate and solve problems
before they happen. And you want to know that you have proven industry specialists that have the
capacity and flexibility to deliver value at any point in your storage tank lifecycle.

Tanks Direct is the leading national industry contractor that offers full-service solutions for
water and petroleum storage. Partnering with customers from design through construction and
installation, to maintenance and removal, we strive to be your “first choice.” As a single source
storage tank distributor, you can count on our expertise and knowledge at any life cycle stage of
your tank needs.

[Considerations When Selecting an Ultrasonic Level Meter]
Considerations When Selecting an Ultrasonic Level Meter
Considerations When Selecting an Ultrasonic Level Meter An ultrasonic level meter can only be used
with media capable of adequately reflecting and transmitting sound waves. This is because the
operating principle of an ultrasonic level meter relies on sound wave reflection to measure the
liquid level. For example, in media such as clean water or common oils, sound waves can be well
reflected and transmitted, enabling accurate measurement. However, for media with strong
sound-absorbing properties—such as certain types of foam or substances with high acoustic
absorption—an ultrasonic level meter is not suitable. In such media, sound waves are heavily
absorbed during transmission and cannot be effectively reflected back to the sensor, resulting in
inaccurate measurements or even measurement failure. Ultrasonic level meters cannot be used in
vacuum environments and are not suitable for negative-pressure conditions. As is well known,
ultrasonic waves require air as a medium for propagation. In a vacuum, there is no medium for sound
to travel through, making measurement impossible. In negative-pressure environments, the thin air
severely impedes sound transmission, causing increased attenuation and therefore large measurement
errors or inability to measure at all. For example, ultrasonic level meters cannot be used in highly
vacuumed laboratory equipment or extremely negative-pressure containers. If the measured medium is
volatile, or contains significant amounts of moisture, dust, bubbles, or suspended particles, an
ultrasonic level meter is not recommended. When the emitted sound waves encounter such media,
irregular reflection and scattering occur. For instance, in dusty media, sound waves interact with
dust particles during propagation, altering their transmission path and preventing the sensor from
receiving normal signals. Additionally, these media absorb sound waves, causing attenuation that
severely affects measurement accuracy. If there are obstacles or equipment inside the container that
affect the propagation of sound waves, selecting an ultrasonic level meter is not advisable. For
example, internal structures such as complex piping or mixing devices interfere with normal sound
transmission and reflection, resulting in inaccurate level measurements. Ultrasonic level meters are
generally suitable only for applications within normal temperature and pressure ranges. Typically,
excessively high pressure can strongly inhibit the speed of sound, affecting measurement accuracy or
preventing measurement altogether. In addition, the operating temperature generally should not
exceed 100°C.

[Considerations When Selecting an Ultrasonic Level Meter]
Considerations When Selecting an Ultrasonic Level Meter
Considerations When Selecting an Ultrasonic Level Meter An ultrasonic level meter can only be used
with media capable of adequately reflecting and transmitting sound waves. This is because the
operating principle of an ultrasonic level meter relies on sound wave reflection to measure the
liquid level. For example, in media such as clean water or common oils, sound waves can be well
reflected and transmitted, enabling accurate measurement. However, for media with strong
sound-absorbing properties—such as certain types of foam or substances with high acoustic
absorption—an ultrasonic level meter is not suitable. In such media, sound waves are heavily
absorbed during transmission and cannot be effectively reflected back to the sensor, resulting in
inaccurate measurements or even measurement failure. Ultrasonic level meters cannot be used in
vacuum environments and are not suitable for negative-pressure conditions. As is well known,
ultrasonic waves require air as a medium for propagation. In a vacuum, there is no medium for sound
to travel through, making measurement impossible. In negative-pressure environments, the thin air
severely impedes sound transmission, causing increased attenuation and therefore large measurement
errors or inability to measure at all. For example, ultrasonic level meters cannot be used in highly
vacuumed laboratory equipment or extremely negative-pressure containers. If the measured medium is
volatile, or contains significant amounts of moisture, dust, bubbles, or suspended particles, an
ultrasonic level meter is not recommended. When the emitted sound waves encounter such media,
irregular reflection and scattering occur. For instance, in dusty media, sound waves interact with
dust particles during propagation, altering their transmission path and preventing the sensor from
receiving normal signals. Additionally, these media absorb sound waves, causing attenuation that
severely affects measurement accuracy. If there are obstacles or equipment inside the container that
affect the propagation of sound waves, selecting an ultrasonic level meter is not advisable. For
example, internal structures such as complex piping or mixing devices interfere with normal sound
transmission and reflection, resulting in inaccurate level measurements. Ultrasonic level meters are
generally suitable only for applications within normal temperature and pressure ranges. Typically,
excessively high pressure can strongly inhibit the speed of sound, affecting measurement accuracy or
preventing measurement altogether. In addition, the operating temperature generally should not
exceed 100°C.

# Track tank levels remotely and plan refills or pickups before they become urgent.

Avoid emergency deliveries, last-minute pickups, and manual tank checks.

Remote tank monitoring powered by reliable hardware and predictive analytics.

## Trusted Sensing Hardware

[FoxRadar (Gen 4)][8]·[FoxPressure (Gen 4)][9]·[Hall Pro][10]·[Pressure Ex][11]

Certified sensing hardware for fuel, lubricant, and waste oil environments.

[Explore hardware →][12]

## From Monitoring to Service Insight

Sensors capture fill levels. Consumption models predict when tanks need attention.

FoxInsights turns level data into service timing — enabling planners to schedule refills or
collections before sites run dry or overflow.

Execution stays with your operations team. The platform provides the timing.

See how this applies to [lubricant][13] and [UCO][14] operations →

Built for distributors managing tank networks across multiple locations.

Not designed for single-site monitoring or individual tank owners.

## Built for Your Industry

FoxInsights supports distributors managing tank operations across:

### Lubricant Distribution

Predictive refill intelligence across your customers' lubricant tanks.

[Explore →][15]
[Read the guide →][16]

### UCO Collection

Data-driven collection planning for your UCO container fleet.

[Explore →][17]
[Read the guide →][18]

### Heating Oil Supply

Forecast-driven delivery planning for your heating oil tanks.

[Explore →][19]
[Read the guide →][20]

### Diesel Distribution

Structured visibility across your diesel tank network.

[Explore →][21]
[Read the guide →][22]

### Waste Oil Collection

Improve collection planning with reliable tank level visibility.

[Explore →][23]

### LPG Supply

Consumption-based refill insight for your LPG tanks.

[Explore →][24]

## The Intelligence Layer

FoxPortal centralizes portfolio-wide tank visibility and forecasting insight in one structured
interface.
* Real-time visibility
* Forecast-based service timing
* Structured delivery planning support

[Explore the platform →][25]
[FoxPortal dashboard showing tank levels, device status, and order probability across a distributed
tank network]

## The Sensing Layer

Reliable data begins with accurate measurement.

### FoxInsights hardware:
* [FoxRadar (Gen 4)][26]
* [FoxPressure (Gen 4)][27]
* [Hall Pro][28]
* [Pressure Ex][29]
* [FoxHall][30]

Each device delivers consistent level data as the foundation for forecasting and service insight.

[Explore hardware →][31]
[FoxRadar sensor device with FoxPortal mobile and desktop dashboard views]

## Move beyond reactive coordination.

Predictive service timing for tank operations across sites.

[Talk to a specialist][32]

Structured operational intelligence for your tank network.

# API Inspection & API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment

**Inspection 4 Industry LLC** provides API inspection training and API 579 Fitness for Service
Assessment (FFS) services for the oil and gas and process industries, supporting pressure vessels,
piping systems, and aboveground storage tanks.

I4I Academy provides Online API Inspector Training Courses, including API 510 pressure vessel
inspector training course, API 570 piping inspector training course, API 653 aboveground storage
tank inspector training course, API Source inspector training course, API 1104 welding of pipelines
and related facilities training course, API 571 Corrosion and Materials training course, and API 580
Risk Based Inspection training course. Multiple ASME courses are also provided, including courses
about ASME Section VIII Div.1, IX, and V.

Inspection 4 Industry LLC provides [API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment][170] (FFS) services for
common damage mechanisms (metal loss, pitting, cracking, hydrogen damage, dents and gouges, fire
damage, creep, laminations, fatigue, and more). If API 579 FFS is needed for your equipment, contact
Inspection 4 Industry LLC and we can perform the assessment and deliver a complete engineering
report with a clear fit-for-service decision and any required operating limits.


## API Inspection Training Courses

Welcome to the [I4I Academy][171], where our online API Inspector Training courses stand out with an
unparalleled success rate in API Individual Certification Program Exams. We take pride in achieving
a remarkable pass rate of over 95% for participants in our API 510, API 570, and API 653 training
courses, with the majority succeeding in their certification exams on the very first attempt.

Our courses are meticulously designed to provide a comprehensive and effective learning experience.

mirrors in-person training, ensuring a thorough understanding of the subject matter.

[I4I Academy Courses]

To supplement the video sessions, participants receive a detailed and comprehensive course handout
that serves as a valuable reference throughout their studies. We understand the importance of
practice in exam preparation, which is why we provide access to a rich repository of 1000 practice
exam questions through our Quiz Question Banks. This extensive collection allows students to
reinforce their understanding, identify areas for improvement, and build confidence as they progress
through the course.

As a testament to our commitment to thorough exam preparation, each course includes a timed final
exam, functioning as a mock-up of the API certification exam. This simulation enables students to
experience exam conditions, refine their time-management skills, and gauge their readiness for the
actual certification test.

At I4I Academy, we prioritize flexibility and convenience for our students. They have the freedom to
proceed with their studies at their own pace, ensuring a personalized and stress-free learning
journey. We recognize that every individual has a unique learning style and schedule, and our
courses are tailored to accommodate these differences.

Choose the I4I Academy for API Inspector Training courses and join the ranks of successful
professionals who have not only gained valuable knowledge but have also achieved certification
excellence. Your success is our priority, and our courses are crafted to guide you towards a
fulfilling and rewarding career in API inspection.

## API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment (FFS)

Inspection 4 Industry LLC provides API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment (FFS) services and a
complete set of online screening tools to help you quickly identify the most appropriate API 579
Part for your damage condition and determine whether a formal FFS evaluation is likely needed.

Our API 579 screening tools are organized by damage mechanism and structured by Part, so you can
follow a clear workflow for each assessment topic—including Part 3 [Brittle Fracture][204], Part 4
[General Metal Loss][205], Part 5 [Local Metal Loss][206], Part 6 [Pitting Corrosion][207], Part 7
[Hydrogen Damage][208], Part 8 [Weld Misalignment and Shell Distortions][209], Part 9 [Crack-Like
Flaws][210], Part 10 [Creep][211], Part 11 [Fire Damage][212], Part 12 [Dents and Gouges][213]
(including dent-gouge combinations), Part 13 [Laminations][214], and Part 14 [Fatigue][215]. Each
tool is designed to be practical for real inspection data and to guide you toward the correct next
step without guessing.

If your screening result indicates that API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment (FFS) is needed,
Inspection 4 Industry LLC can perform the engineering evaluation and deliver a complete report with
a clear fit-for-service decision, any required operating limits, and recommended actions (monitor,
repair, rerate, or mitigation) appropriate to the applicable assessment level.

# API Inspection & API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment

**Inspection 4 Industry LLC** provides API inspection training and API 579 Fitness for Service
Assessment (FFS) services for the oil and gas and process industries, supporting pressure vessels,
piping systems, and aboveground storage tanks.

I4I Academy provides Online API Inspector Training Courses, including API 510 pressure vessel
inspector training course, API 570 piping inspector training course, API 653 aboveground storage
tank inspector training course, API Source inspector training course, API 1104 welding of pipelines
and related facilities training course, API 571 Corrosion and Materials training course, and API 580
Risk Based Inspection training course. Multiple ASME courses are also provided, including courses
about ASME Section VIII Div.1, IX, and V.

Inspection 4 Industry LLC provides [API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment][170] (FFS) services for
common damage mechanisms (metal loss, pitting, cracking, hydrogen damage, dents and gouges, fire
damage, creep, laminations, fatigue, and more). If API 579 FFS is needed for your equipment, contact
Inspection 4 Industry LLC and we can perform the assessment and deliver a complete engineering
report with a clear fit-for-service decision and any required operating limits.

At I4I Academy, we prioritize flexibility and convenience for our students. They have the freedom to

## API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment (FFS)

Inspection 4 Industry LLC provides API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment (FFS) services and a
complete set of online screening tools to help you quickly identify the most appropriate API 579
Part for your damage condition and determine whether a formal FFS evaluation is likely needed.

Our API 579 screening tools are organized by damage mechanism and structured by Part, so you can
follow a clear workflow for each assessment topic—including Part 3 [Brittle Fracture][204], Part 4
[General Metal Loss][205], Part 5 [Local Metal Loss][206], Part 6 [Pitting Corrosion][207], Part 7
[Hydrogen Damage][208], Part 8 [Weld Misalignment and Shell Distortions][209], Part 9 [Crack-Like
Flaws][210], Part 10 [Creep][211], Part 11 [Fire Damage][212], Part 12 [Dents and Gouges][213]
(including dent-gouge combinations), Part 13 [Laminations][214], and Part 14 [Fatigue][215]. Each
tool is designed to be practical for real inspection data and to guide you toward the correct next
step without guessing.

Inspection 4 Industry LLC can perform the engineering evaluation and deliver a complete report with
a clear fit-for-service decision, any required operating limits, and recommended actions (monitor,
repair, rerate, or mitigation) appropriate to the applicable assessment level.

## BEHÄLTER UND SYSTEMLÖSUNGEN FÜR FESTE,
## FLÜSSIGE UND GASFÖRMIGE STOFFE

Die LIPP GmbH in Tannhausen ist Spezialist für den Behälterbau. Wir bieten Ihnen hochwertige
[Behälter][148] und [Systemlösungen][149] aus Stahl für Industrie, Kommunen und Landwirtschaft.
Unsere einzigartige Bauweise im [LIPP^{®}-System][150] erreicht dabei höchste Qualität für die
Lagerung fester, flüssiger und gasförmiger Stoffe. Mit dem Fokus auf Langlebigkeit, Flexibilität und
individueller Anpassbarkeit realisieren wir Ihr Projekt – von einzelnen Behältern bis zur
schlüsselfertigen Anlage.

Wir – die LIPP GmbH – sind ein weltweit agierendes [Familienunternehmen][151] und besitzen 65 Jahre
Erfahrung im Anlagen- und Behälterbau. Mit über 200 bahnbrechenden Patenten haben wir bereits mehr
als 35.000 [Projekte][152] und Behälter auf der ganzen Welt realisiert.

**LIPP – Unique. Worldwide.**

# LIPP GmbH

## BEHÄLTER UND SYSTEMLÖSUNGEN FÜR FESTE,
## FLÜSSIGE UND GASFÖRMIGE STOFFE

Die LIPP GmbH in Tannhausen ist Spezialist für den Behälterbau. Wir bieten Ihnen hochwertige
[Behälter][148] und [Systemlösungen][149] aus Stahl für Industrie, Kommunen und Landwirtschaft.
Unsere einzigartige Bauweise im [LIPP^{®}-System][150] erreicht dabei höchste Qualität für die
Lagerung fester, flüssiger und gasförmiger Stoffe. Mit dem Fokus auf Langlebigkeit, Flexibilität und
individueller Anpassbarkeit realisieren wir Ihr Projekt – von einzelnen Behältern bis zur
schlüsselfertigen Anlage.

Wir – die LIPP GmbH – sind ein weltweit agierendes [Familienunternehmen][151] und besitzen 65 Jahre

## What is MLBBHub?

The data-driven Mobile Legends companion: live stats, tier list, counters, builds and a draft
simulator, free for every ranked player.

**MLBBHub** turns live **Mobile Legends: Bang Bang** ranked data into the tools players actually use
to climb: a daily [tier list][164], instant [counter picks][165], hero [win-rate stats][166], item
and emblem [builds][167], and a full ban-and-pick [draft simulator][168]. Every tool covers all 133
heroes, refreshes daily, and is free with no login.

Pick a hero to scout, find the best counter against an enemy lineup, or [test a full team
composition][169]. No fluff, no drama, just the numbers behind the current meta.

How the data works
* **Updated daily** from ranked win, pick and ban rates across all servers (Patch 2.1.90).
* Tiers use a weighted score of win rate, pick rate and ban rate, reviewed each patch.
* Builds, emblems and items are checked against the live game and official patch notes.

Independent, fan-made companion. Not affiliated with Moonton.

Frequently asked questions

### What is MLBBHub?

MLBBHub is a free, data-driven companion site for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. It tracks live win,
pick and ban rates for all 133 heroes and turns them into a daily tier list, counter picks, hero
builds, matchup data and a full draft simulator, so ranked players can make decisions from real
numbers instead of guesswork.

### Is MLBBHub free to use?

Yes. Every tool on MLBBHub is completely free and works without an account, login or download. You
can open the tier list, counter finder, build simulator and draft simulator straight from your
browser.

### How often is MLBBHub updated?

Hero win, pick and ban rates refresh every day from ranked match data, and the tier list, builds and
patch highlights are reviewed after every Mobile Legends patch (currently Patch 2.1.90). A freshness
stamp on each page shows when it was last updated.

### Where does MLBBHub's data come from?

Win rates, pick rates and ban rates are drawn from Mobile Legends ranked match data across all
servers and shown as rolling seven-day figures. Hero builds, emblems, items and battle spells are
cross-checked against the live game and the official patch notes.

### Is MLBBHub affiliated with Moonton or Mobile Legends?

No. MLBBHub is an independent, fan-made companion site and is not endorsed by or affiliated with
Moonton. Mobile Legends: Bang Bang is a trademark of Moonton; official updates are published at
mobilelegends.com.

### Does MLBBHub work on mobile?

Yes. MLBBHub is mobile-first and installs as a Progressive Web App, so you can check counters, the
tier list and builds from your phone between ranked matches.

## What is MLBBHub?

The data-driven Mobile Legends companion: live stats, tier list, counters, builds and a draft
simulator, free for every ranked player.

**MLBBHub** turns live **Mobile Legends: Bang Bang** ranked data into the tools players actually use
to climb: a daily [tier list][164], instant [counter picks][165], hero [win-rate stats][166], item
and emblem [builds][167], and a full ban-and-pick [draft simulator][168]. Every tool covers all 133
heroes, refreshes daily, and is free with no login.

Pick a hero to scout, find the best counter against an enemy lineup, or [test a full team
composition][169]. No fluff, no drama, just the numbers behind the current meta.

How the data works
* **Updated daily** from ranked win, pick and ban rates across all servers (Patch 2.1.90).
* Tiers use a weighted score of win rate, pick rate and ban rate, reviewed each patch.
* Builds, emblems and items are checked against the live game and official patch notes.

Independent, fan-made companion. Not affiliated with Moonton.

Frequently asked questions

### What is MLBBHub?

MLBBHub is a free, data-driven companion site for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. It tracks live win,
pick and ban rates for all 133 heroes and turns them into a daily tier list, counter picks, hero
builds, matchup data and a full draft simulator, so ranked players can make decisions from real
numbers instead of guesswork.

### Is MLBBHub free to use?

Yes. Every tool on MLBBHub is completely free and works without an account, login or download. You
can open the tier list, counter finder, build simulator and draft simulator straight from your
browser.

### How often is MLBBHub updated?

Hero win, pick and ban rates refresh every day from ranked match data, and the tier list, builds and
patch highlights are reviewed after every Mobile Legends patch (currently Patch 2.1.90). A freshness
stamp on each page shows when it was last updated.

### Where does MLBBHub's data come from?

Win rates, pick rates and ban rates are drawn from Mobile Legends ranked match data across all
servers and shown as rolling seven-day figures. Hero builds, emblems, items and battle spells are
cross-checked against the live game and the official patch notes.

### Is MLBBHub affiliated with Moonton or Mobile Legends?

No. MLBBHub is an independent, fan-made companion site and is not endorsed by or affiliated with
Moonton. Mobile Legends: Bang Bang is a trademark of Moonton; official updates are published at
mobilelegends.com.

### Does MLBBHub work on mobile?

Yes. MLBBHub is mobile-first and installs as a Progressive Web App, so you can check counters, the
tier list and builds from your phone between ranked matches.

## Your Success is Our Priority: Delivering Excellence On Every Deal

###### Nationwide Brokerage Group Inc. connects qualified global buyers with established energy
###### suppliers through a trusted network of verified title holders and internationally recognized
###### refineries. With access to more than 30 refinery relationships, we facilitate efficient,
###### transparent petroleum transactions for buyers seeking reliable fuel supply solutions.
###### 
###### Our portfolio includes Jet A-1 Aviation Fuel, EN590 10 PPM Diesel, D6 Virgin Fuel Oil, and
###### other refined petroleum products. We focus on streamlining the procurement process by
###### coordinating documentation, verifying counterparties, and helping facilitate transactions
###### from initial inquiry through contract execution.
###### 
###### At Nationwide Brokerage Group, we understand that successful energy transactions depend on
###### trust, efficiency, and execution. Our commitment is to provide professional brokerage
###### services, responsive communication, and dependable support that help serious buyers navigate
###### today's complex global petroleum market with confidence.

[NATIONWIDEBGNY.COM]

## Efficient and Reliable Fuel Source 

[
[nationwidebgny.com]
][45]

### EN590 10PPM

We are pleased to offer unrestricted access to

EN590 10ppm diesel fuel, readily available at your port of choice. This offering is supported by our
established, long-term relationships with reputable refineries. Please be advised that EN590
complies with the European standard for diesel fuel, featuring a sulfur content of 10 parts per
million (PPM). This product is intended for commercial transactions in significant volumes.

[
[nationwidebgny.com]
][46]

### D6 Virgin Oil

Leveraging our direct refinery access, we ensure a reliable supply of D6 Virgin Oil, coupled with
competitive pricing and global port storage solutions. D6 fuel, also referred to as Residual Fuel
Oil or Bunker C, is a high-viscosity fuel primarily designed for large-scale industrial
applications, including marine engines, power generators, and industrial furnaces. This fuel is
produced during the concluding phases of crude oil distillation and requires preheating to reduce
viscosity, thereby facilitating optimal performance in these extensive systems. 



[
[nationwidebgny.com]
][47]

### JET A-1

By procuring jet fuel directly from refineries, we are able to provide our customers with a
continuous supply at the most advantageous prices. Jet fuel, which is mainly kerosene-based, is a
specialized fuel designed for aircraft, adhering to specific performance standards. The standard
grades include Jet A for domestic and Jet A-1 for international civilian applications, in addition
to military grades such as JP-5 and JP-8. Furthermore, additives, such as antioxidants and static
dissipators, are included to enhance both performance and safety. 

[
[NATIONWIDEBGNY.COM]
][48]

### Crude Oli

Our resources include the four main categories of crude oil: light, heavy, sweet, and sour.
Moreover, we have access to a significant producer of high-quality heavy crude oil among the six
largest producing countries. Crude oil is understood to be a naturally occurring blend of
hydrocarbons, found in a liquid state within underground reservoirs and remaining liquid at
atmospheric pressure after surface separation procedures.

## Your Success is Our Priority: Delivering Excellence On Every Deal

###### Nationwide Brokerage Group Inc. connects qualified global buyers with established energy
###### suppliers through a trusted network of verified title holders and internationally recognized
###### refineries. With access to more than 30 refinery relationships, we facilitate efficient,
###### transparent petroleum transactions for buyers seeking reliable fuel supply solutions.
###### 
###### Our portfolio includes Jet A-1 Aviation Fuel, EN590 10 PPM Diesel, D6 Virgin Fuel Oil, and
###### other refined petroleum products. We focus on streamlining the procurement process by
###### coordinating documentation, verifying counterparties, and helping facilitate transactions
###### from initial inquiry through contract execution.
###### 
###### At Nationwide Brokerage Group, we understand that successful energy transactions depend on
###### trust, efficiency, and execution. Our commitment is to provide professional brokerage
###### services, responsive communication, and dependable support that help serious buyers navigate
###### today's complex global petroleum market with confidence.

[NATIONWIDEBGNY.COM]

## Efficient and Reliable Fuel Source 

[
[nationwidebgny.com]
][45]

### EN590 10PPM

We are pleased to offer unrestricted access to

EN590 10ppm diesel fuel, readily available at your port of choice. This offering is supported by our
established, long-term relationships with reputable refineries. Please be advised that EN590
complies with the European standard for diesel fuel, featuring a sulfur content of 10 parts per
million (PPM). This product is intended for commercial transactions in significant volumes.

[
[nationwidebgny.com]
][46]

### D6 Virgin Oil

Leveraging our direct refinery access, we ensure a reliable supply of D6 Virgin Oil, coupled with
competitive pricing and global port storage solutions. D6 fuel, also referred to as Residual Fuel
Oil or Bunker C, is a high-viscosity fuel primarily designed for large-scale industrial
applications, including marine engines, power generators, and industrial furnaces. This fuel is
produced during the concluding phases of crude oil distillation and requires preheating to reduce
viscosity, thereby facilitating optimal performance in these extensive systems. 



[
[nationwidebgny.com]
][47]

### JET A-1

By procuring jet fuel directly from refineries, we are able to provide our customers with a
continuous supply at the most advantageous prices. Jet fuel, which is mainly kerosene-based, is a
specialized fuel designed for aircraft, adhering to specific performance standards. The standard
grades include Jet A for domestic and Jet A-1 for international civilian applications, in addition
to military grades such as JP-5 and JP-8. Furthermore, additives, such as antioxidants and static
dissipators, are included to enhance both performance and safety. 

[
[NATIONWIDEBGNY.COM]
][48]

### Crude Oli

Our resources include the four main categories of crude oil: light, heavy, sweet, and sour.
Moreover, we have access to a significant producer of high-quality heavy crude oil among the six
largest producing countries. Crude oil is understood to be a naturally occurring blend of
hydrocarbons, found in a liquid state within underground reservoirs and remaining liquid at
atmospheric pressure after surface separation procedures.

[

Self-Forcing Braided Sleeve Gripper: A Soft Robotics Approach to Offshore Conductor Removal

][9]
Master thesis (2026) - [C. Dielas][10], [J. Jovanova][11], J. Breukels, [V.G. Kortman][12], [H.L.
McQuillan][13], [Jieun Yang][14]

Offshore decommissioning is accelerating asageing oil and gas infrastructure reaches the end of its
service life. In theNorth Sea alone, over 2,650 wells are scheduled between 2025 and 2034, and
wellplug and abandonment accounted for 49% of decommissioning expenditure on the UKContinental Shelf
in 2024. Within this scope, conductor removal, the extractionof large-diameter vertical steel pipes
connecting subsea wells to surfacefacilities, remains a persistent operational bottleneck. Current
practice relieson the cut-and-pull method, in which the entire lifting load is transferredthrough a
single conductor cross-section. Its applicability is thereforegoverned by the structural condition
of that cross-section, as corroded casingsand degraded connections may not sustain the concentrated
load.

This thesis proposes a compliant grippingmechanism that distributes the lifting load over the outer
conductor surface,and examines whether it scales to the multi-tonne loads of conductor removal,
aregime far beyond the small-scale applications to which soft robotic grippershave been confined.
Following a literature study into soft gripping methods anda conceptual design process, four
concepts were evaluated, from which a braidedconstriction sleeve gripper was selected. Its defining
property is aself-forcing mechanism, in which the weight of the conductor tightens the braidaround
its surface, so that a heavier load produces a stronger grip.

An analytical model relates the braidgeometry to the holding capacity, which grows exponentially
with adimensionless self-forcing coefficient. This coefficient is the product of thefriction
coefficient and a geometric coefficient scaling with the conductorradius and the square of the
number of braid turns, and inversely with thegripping length. The capacity is supplied passively by
the weight of a bottomring, requiring no continuous actuation. A parametric campaign across
twelveconfigurations, each tested five times, supported the model within the rangeexamined. The
measured capacity scaled linearly with the ring weight at fixedgeometry, rose far more steeply with
the geometric coefficient than preloadfriction alone permits, following the exponential form
characteristic ofself-forcing, and followed the predicted direction for each geometric
parametervaried in isolation. A single friction coefficient of approximately 0.135reproduced the
measured capacity across differing geometries, supporting thecontact assumptions. The most tightly
braided configuration sustained more than75 kg without slipping, giving a payload-to-self-weight
ratio of at least 337:1against 16:1 at the baseline.Applied to the NorthCormorant platform, the
model yields an early-phase full-scale design employinga steel wire rope braid of seven turns over a
gripping length of 14 metres,preloaded by a 10 tonne bottom ring. Under a conservative design
frictioncoefficient of 0.10, the holding capacity reaches approximately 18,800 kNagainst a design
lifting weight of 634 kN per conductor section. Slip istherefore not the governing constraint, which
is set instead by the ropestrength at the top ring connection and by the deployment of the braid. To
theauthor's knowledge, this constitutes the first compliant gripping conceptmodelled, experimentally
supported, and dimensioned for offshore removals atthe multi-tonne scale. ... Read more

[

Steering the story

][15]

Assessing narrative-shift potential in mobility-focused urban living labs

Master thesis (2026) - [J.P. Wendling][16], [C. Wehrmann][17], [S.M. Flipse][18], [U. Pesch][19],
[J. van Keulen][20]
Mobility transitions are shaped not only by infrastructure, technology and policy, but also by
narratives: shared understandings, in this case about what forms of mobility are considered normal,
desirable, feasible and acceptable. These days, dominant mobility narratives are often car-centred,
which can limit the adoption of more sustainable mobility practices. Urban living labs may offer
conditions in which alternative mobility narratives can be experienced, discussed and developed,
because they combine real-world experimentation, local embedding, stakeholder collaboration and
participant involvement. However, it remains unclear how the narrative-shift potential of
mobility-focused urban living labs can be assessed or strengthened in practice.
This thesis investigates how the narrative-shift potential of mobility-focused urban living labs can
be assessed and translates this into a practical design-support tool for organisers. Narrative-shift
potential is defined as the extent to which a living lab contains theoretically grounded design
conditions that may support participants or relevant actors in engaging with, reflecting on and
possibly adopting or diffusing an alternative mobility narrative. The thesis does not measure actual
participant-level narrative change.
The thesis consists of two main sections: a research and design section. The research section is
aimed at answering the research question: “How can the narrative-shift potential of mobility-focused
urban living labs be assessed?”. The design section is aimed at answering the design question: “How
can the assessment of narrative-shift potential be translated into a practical design-support tool
for organisers of mobility-focused urban living labs?”.
The research combines a targeted literature review, rubric development and qualitative multiple-case
study analysis. Literature on mobility narratives, narrative persuasion and urban living labs is
synthesised into six mechanisms associated with narrative-shift potential: deep immersion,
reflexivity, participatory approach, socio-spatial relevance, network nurturing and social network
inclusion. These mechanisms are operationalised into a ULL characterisation rubric and applied to
three real-world cases: GEMINI, ALTHEA and sCOOL2walk.
The analysis shows that across cases, socio-spatial relevance, deep immersion and network nurturing
are relatively strong, while reflexivity and social network inclusion are less deliberately
developed. This suggests that mobility-focused urban living labs may already contain implicit
narrative-shift potential, but that this potential is not always intentionally recognised or
designed for.
The design phase translates these findings into the ULL Optimisation Tool, consisting of a ULL
framing canvas, assessment rubric, mechanism prompt cards and optimisation canvas. A validation step
led to the addition of a living lab fit check, a clearer distinction between target groups, users
and enabling actors, and an explicit access check before participant-facing interventions are
selected. The final output is a workshop-based tool that helps organisers define the intended
narrative shift, assess mechanism expression, prioritise improvement opportunities and translate
them into design interventions.
The tool helps organisers make narrative-shift potential explicit and identify context-specific
opportunities for strengthening it. The thesis contributes a theoretically grounded and practically
usable approach for assessing and designing conditions associated with narrative-shift potential in
mobility-focused urban living labs. ... Read more

steel wire rope braid of seven turns over a gripping length of 14 metres,preloaded by a 10 tonne
bottom ring. Under a conservative design frictioncoefficient of 0.10, the holding capacity reaches
approximately 18,800 kNagainst a design lifting weight of 634 kN per conductor section. Slip

atthe multi-tonne scale.

Steering the story

][15]

Assessing narrative-shift potential in mobility-focused urban living labs

Master thesis (2026) - [J.P. Wendling][16], [C. Wehrmann][17], [S.M. Flipse][18], [U. Pesch][19],
[J. van Keulen][20]
Mobility transitions are shaped not only by infrastructure, technology and policy, but also by
narratives: shared understandings, in this case about what forms of mobility are considered normal,
desirable, feasible and acceptable. These days, dominant mobility narratives are often car-centred,
which can limit the adoption of more sustainable mobility practices. Urban living labs may offer
conditions in which alternative mobility narratives can be experienced, discussed and developed,
because they combine real-world experimentation, local embedding, stakeholder collaboration and
participant involvement. However, it remains unclear how the narrative-shift potential of
mobility-focused urban living labs can be assessed or strengthened in practice.
This thesis investigates how the narrative-shift potential of mobility-focused urban living labs can
be assessed and translates this into a practical design-support tool for organisers. Narrative-shift
potential is defined as the extent to which a living lab contains theoretically grounded design
conditions that may support participants or relevant actors in engaging with, reflecting on and
possibly adopting or diffusing an alternative mobility narrative. The thesis does not measure actual
participant-level narrative change.
The thesis consists of two main sections: a research and design section. The research section is
aimed at answering the research question: “How can the narrative-shift potential of mobility-focused
urban living labs be assessed?”. The design section is aimed at answering the design question: “How
can the assessment of narrative-shift potential be translated into a practical design-support tool
for organisers of mobility-focused urban living labs?”.
The research combines a targeted literature review, rubric development and qualitative multiple-case
study analysis. Literature on mobility narratives, narrative persuasion and urban living labs is
synthesised into six mechanisms associated with narrative-shift potential: deep immersion,
reflexivity, participatory approach, socio-spatial relevance, network nurturing and social network
inclusion. These mechanisms are operationalised into a ULL characterisation rubric and applied to
three real-world cases: GEMINI, ALTHEA and sCOOL2walk.
The analysis shows that across cases, socio-spatial relevance, deep immersion and network nurturing
are relatively strong, while reflexivity and social network inclusion are less deliberately
developed. This suggests that mobility-focused urban living labs may already contain implicit
narrative-shift potential, but that this potential is not always intentionally recognised or
designed for.
The design phase translates these findings into the ULL Optimisation Tool, consisting of a ULL
framing canvas, assessment rubric, mechanism prompt cards and optimisation canvas. A validation step
led to the addition of a living lab fit check, a clearer distinction between target groups, users
and enabling actors, and an explicit access check before participant-facing interventions are
selected. The final output is a workshop-based tool that helps organisers define the intended
narrative shift, assess mechanism expression, prioritise improvement opportunities and translate
them into design interventions.
The tool helps organisers make narrative-shift potential explicit and identify context-specific
opportunities for strengthening it. The thesis contributes a theoretically grounded and practically
usable approach for assessing and designing conditions associated with narrative-shift potential in
mobility-focused urban living labs. ... Read more

## analysis and for a vast range of steady state and dynamic applications.

### PIPENET Spray/Sprinkler

Specifically intended for the design of fire protection systems. PIPENET Spray/Sprinkler module
complies with the NFPA rules and more.

### PIPENET Transient

A versatile, user friendly and extremely powerful software tool for modelling transient state
phenomena, and calculating the resultant hydraulic transient forces.

[Read more][37]

### PIPENET Standard

A steady state fluid flow analysis software for compressible and incompressible flow. For
applications such as air, water, steam utility systems design, & ventilation systems.

engineering with premium materials to work with active or passive fire protection systems and comply

Vertical water storage tanks allow for a smaller footprint and reduced land acquisition for
stormwater management.

[Read more][52]

Water tanks can help to reduce infrastructure costs by capturing water for irrigation and
agriculture.

functional water storage tank.

Water tanks on towers provide for gravity flow as well as make a highly visual statement.  Fully
functional wood or metal [water storage tanks and signage on engineered towers][46] designed to
support the load and compliment your architecture and design.

### RAINWATER HARVESTING TANKS

[Rainwater harvesting][48] is a cost saving alternative to relying on a well or municipal water
lines.  Often times local tax credits and other benefits are also available in many areas.
 Rainwater catchment is also a very visual statement supporting water conservation initiatives.

### FIRE PROTECTION TANKS

[Fire protection tanks][50] are a cost effective alternative for developments. Our tanks are
engineering with premium materials to work with active or passive fire protection systems and comply
with NFPA standards.

[Read more][51]

### STORMWATER MANAGEMENT

Vertical water storage tanks allow for a smaller footprint and reduced land acquisition for
stormwater management.

[Read more][52]

### AGRICULTURE & IRRIGATION

Water tanks can help to reduce infrastructure costs by capturing water for irrigation and
agriculture.

[Read more][53]

Water Storage Tanks are widely used by breweries and vineyards as well as distilleries for
production, as well as irrigation, fire protection, and grey water reuse.

[Read more][55]

Our traditional TimberTanks are made from premium eastern red cedar and make for a beautiful and
functional water storage tank.

[Read more][56]

CorGal Water Storage Tanks are made in the USA with US Steel, Liners and Hardware from US Suppliers.
